title_zh: 城市养蜂与社区授粉项目

cue_card.prompt: Describe a community-based project that uses an unusual method to improve the local environment.
bullets: what the project sets out to achieve
how local residents are involved in it
why the method used by the project interests you

part3.question: Why might unconventional environmental projects attract more attention than conventional clean-up campaigns?
What difficulties can arise when volunteers try to keep a small community project running for several years?
Should local authorities fund experimental projects proposed by residents, or reserve public money for proven methods?

fallback_questions: How can local authorities persuade residents to take more responsibility for shared outdoor spaces?
Are environmental improvements in cities better achieved by small community groups or by large organisations?
What part should private companies play in supporting neighbourhood projects?
